title: lines dash fills patterns
rule: Lines use dash styles; fills use patterns (max 4–5). Solid / dashed / dotted / dash-dot for series. Hatch/dot/grid for bars, area, pie — not for lines. Two colours per pattern (fill + stroke).
pass_when: Line series use dash styles; area/bar/pie fills use patterns (≤4–5) with two colours per pattern; patterns are not used on lines.
fail_when: Line series distinguished only by colour with no dash; patterns on lines; more than 5 fill patterns.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: Established colour conventions as a merge that drops dash/pattern.
